name: Stormpike Banner
summary: In Alterac Valley, Alliance recruits brave harpies to claim the Stormpike Banner. The trial lies southwest of Dun Baldar in Icewing Cavern.

sections.title: A Rite of Induction
sections.body: Lieutenant Haggerdin sends new Alliance soldiers into Icewing Cavern, southwest of Dun Baldar. Before facing the Frostwolf orcs, each recruit must brave the harpies and seize the Stormpike Banner. Those who bring it back earn the rank and insignia of an initiate in the Stormpike Guard.

faq.q: Where is the Stormpike Banner located?
faq.answer: The Stormpike Banner lies deep inside Icewing Cavern, southwest of Dun Baldar in Alterac Valley.

faq.q: Why do recruits have to retrieve the banner?
faq.answer: Lieutenant Haggerdin asks Alliance recruits to prove their courage before joining the battle lines. Bringing back the banner earns them their first Stormpike Insignia.

faq.q: What threats guard the banner inside the cave?
faq.answer: Savage local harpies guard Icewing Cavern and attack anyone who enters seeking the banner.

faq.q: Who do I return the banner to once found?
faq.answer: Return the banner to Lieutenant Haggerdin, the Alliance officer stationed outside the cave entrance in the Alterac Mountains.

angles.text: As an Alliance recruit, bringing back the banner earns you entry into the Stormpike Guard and the right to carry its battle insignia against the Frostwolf Clan.
As a dwarf, you see the banner as a sign of Ironforge's claim and the Stormpike clan's mission to uncover relics of their past throughout the valley.
